cells.scene: A hand uses a rounded scoop to dig sand out of a small hollow, fresh heap of sand beside the hole.
A carpenter drives a nail into a wooden board with a handheld hammer, clear controlled striking motion and no injury.
Dark storm clouds gather over a small sailing boat, the sailor looks worried at the threatening sky.
A sleeve catches on a protruding nail and tears, a clearly visible jagged opening in the fabric, no wounded skin.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — scoop (v.挖出): A hand uses a rounded scoop to dig sand out of a small hollow, fresh heap of sand beside the hole.
TOP RIGHT — hammer (v.(用锤)击打，锤打): A carpenter drives a nail into a wooden board with a handheld hammer, clear controlled striking motion and no injury.
BOTTOM LEFT — ominously (ad.有预兆的，不祥的): Dark storm clouds gather over a small sailing boat, the sailor looks worried at the threatening sky.
BOTTOM RIGHT — rip (v.划破，撕，扯): A sleeve catches on a protruding nail and tears, a clearly visible jagged opening in the fabric, no wounded skin.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: Each selected sense and quadrant boundary checked. Ominously has looming storm clouds, rip shows a torn sleeve caught by a nail, shallow shows ankle-deep water, grind shows grain becoming flour, and stretch is a long area of beach.
